name_note: The GTDB name carries the suffix _A because GTDB splits the classical genus Blautia; the species is named Blautia caecimuris in the literature.

sentences.text: In fifteen adult recipients of allogeneic haematopoietic stem cell transplantation, Blautia caecimuris and Enterococcus showed significant changes between stool collected before transplantation and after engraftment.

In a twelve-week programme of caloric restriction with strength and interval training in patients with obesity, Blautia caecimuris was among random forest predictors discriminating participants before and after the intervention.
In a study of 61 patients with major depressive disorder and 84 healthy controls, the abundance of Blautia caecimuris correlated positively with processing speed and attention scores.
